acceptance_signals: The task binds resolved alignment journey mcpj-d3402c1828a34ea3bca54073af84e7bc and the human-selected diagnose-initialization-first direction without treating alignment as task admission.
The diagnostic reuses only the retained disposable Python 3.11 runtime and remote-free AIRBNB clone from the prior bounded run, after confirming their recorded identities and preservation state.
A direct AgentGov stdio initialize probe and a Codex host-side no-model thread-start probe use the same process-local runtime, clone configuration, and temporary worktree trust boundary.
The result distinguishes, as far as deterministic evidence permits, server process startup, MCP initialize response, and Codex host integration without invoking a model turn.

If the root boundary cannot be distinguished, the evidence records the smallest remaining unknown and stops without repair, coaching, retry, wrapper installation, dependency download, or configuration persistence.
No raw prompt, response, transcript, source content, credential, private data, temporary absolute path, or unbounded host log is retained.
The original AIRBNB repository, prior runtimes, Starter source, user Codex configuration, credentials, Git state, remotes, and external systems remain unchanged.
The experiment record, current status, and dated log report the exact normalized result and identify any superseded current-status statement without rewriting historical evidence.

The exact task and repository checks, cumulative scope reconciliation, task JSON parsing, bounded privacy scans, baseline test suite, and git diff check pass or truthfully report preserved excluded state.
The task stops before any product-source repair, consumer repair, model turn, second live replay, dependency download, cleanup, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or broader activation.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-e8d970b4706740dd9c240a5824998ddf and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Run one bounded deterministic no-model diagnostic against the retained disposable AgentGov runtime and remote-free AIRBNB clone to distinguish AgentGov server startup, MCP initialize response, and Codex host integration at the previously measured thread-start boundary. Record only sanitized evidence, make no product or consumer repair, and do not start a model turn or second live replay.

items: A host-side thread-start probe could accidentally advance toward model execution unless it stops before any turn-start request.
Reading broad Codex or MCP logs could retain raw prompts, credentials, source content, or absolute paths unless evidence is restricted to normalized protocol and exit facts.
The retained temporary runtime or clone may have drifted since the prior run and must fail closed if identity checks do not match.
Process-local trust or environment overrides could become persistent if written to user configuration.
A diagnosis may reveal a likely repair but does not authorize implementing it.
The current Starter worktree contains changes from the completed recovery task and user-owned excluded paths that must remain preserved and outside this diagnostic's ownership.
Reviewed assumption: The retained disposable runtime and bound AIRBNB clone still exist.
Reviewed assumption: The Codex app-server or equivalent host protocol can exercise thread initialization without sending a model turn.
Reviewed assumption: Direct stdio MCP initialization can be repeated without network access or repository mutation.
Reviewed assumption: Python 3.11 or newer and the current Codex executable remain available.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the prior initialize failure originated before the AgentGov process started, during its initialize response, or while Codex consumed that response.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the failure is reproducible through a no-model Codex host protocol.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a bounded child-process diagnostic surface exposes enough normalized error detail without reading retained raw logs.

title: Diagnose the installed Codex-to-AgentGov initialize handshake
